reasoning_content: Java didn't install. Let me check what's available or install it differently.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Check available Java
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("apt-cache search openjdk | grep -E 'jdk.*17|openjdk.*17' | head -5")
print("Available:", stdout.read().decode())

# Try alternative install
c.exec_command("apt-get install -y openjdk-17-jdk-headless 2>&1 | tail -5")

# Find Java home
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("update-java-alternatives -l 2>/dev/null || ls /usr/lib/jvm/")
print("JVM:", stdout.read().decode())

c.close()
EOF
